title: Marketing Coordinator
description:
This is an exciting opportunity for a creative and organised marketing professional looking to develop their career within a varied and hands-on role. Whether you're seeking a full-time position or a part-time opportunity that fits around other commitments, our client is open to finding the right arrangement for the successful candidate.

Working closely with key stakeholders, you will support the planning and delivery of marketing campaigns, manage digital content, and help drive brand awareness across a range of channels.

Key Responsibilities
- Support the planning and execution of marketing campaigns across digital and traditional channels.
- Create engaging content for social media, websites, email campaigns, blogs, and promotional materials.
- Manage and update social media platforms, ensuring consistent brand messaging.
- Assist with website content updates and basic SEO activities.
- Coordinate email marketing campaigns and monitor engagement metrics.
- Design and produce marketing collateral, presentations, and promotional materials.
- Support the organisation of events, exhibitions, and networking activities.

What We're Looking For
- Previous experience in a marketing, communications, or digital marketing role.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Excellent organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines.
- Experience using social media platforms for business purposes.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.
- Working knowledge of tools such as Canva, Mailchimp, WordPress, Google Analytics, or similar marketing platforms would be advantageous.
- A proactive attitude with a willingness to learn and contribute new ideas.

What's on Offer?
- Full-time or part-time hours available.
- Opportunity to work within a supportive and collaborative team.
- Varied role with scope for development and progression.
- Training and professional development opportunities.
- Competitive salary and benefits package.

Apply Today

If you're a creative and organised marketing professional looking for a new challenge with flexibility around hours, we'd love to hear from you.
